description: Renders and exports a sequence to a video file. This is for creating the final video.

allowOverwrite.description: Allow writing to an existing output file. Defaults to false.

format.description: Deprecated hint only; the .epr preset controls codec/container.

outputPath.description: The absolute path where the final video file will be saved

presetName.description: Exact user preset display name or filename stem. Must resolve to exactly one discovered .epr preset.

presetPath.description: Absolute path to an export preset file (.epr). Required unless presetName uniquely resolves through get_encoder_presets.

quality.description: Deprecated hint only; the .epr preset controls quality.

removeOnCompletion.description: Pass AME removeOnCompletion. Defaults to true to preserve existing queue behavior.

resolution.description: Deprecated hint only; the .epr preset controls resolution.

sequenceId.description: The ID of the sequence to export. Defaults to the active sequence.

sourceRange.description: Export source range. Defaults to entire. Requested ranges are never silently substituted.

name: export_sequence
